messages:
maria: Quick sync — follow-up from the billing postmortem. We confirmed a delayed token ingestion window (2026-03-12 02:00–04:20 UTC) that produced late usage spikes for ~2k customers. Need clear owners for: backfill/replay, invoice corrections, and customer comms. @ana can you take invoice adjustments? @samir can you own the backfill plan? @jake can ops own pre-job capacity/alerts?

ana: I can own invoice corrections. I need the canonical corrected counts plus mapped invoice ids and a rough cost/credit estimate. Once I have that I'll coordinate support comms and batching for reissues (48–72h after counts).

samir: On the backfill side — root cause looks like a GC-induced pause on metering-worker consuming from Kafka which let a ~2h window backlog pile up. Plan: roll the GC tuning + consumer fix tonight, then run ledger-replay with rate-limits. Proposed kickoff: 06:00 UTC tomorrow; estimate ~6h for the replay for full backlog. I'll post the replay runbook and checklist here.

jake: Ops will prep capacity and increase consumer parallelism for the window. I'll add an alert for consumer lag > 10m and a preflight checklist (disk/CPU/memory) that we run before the replay job. Adding to eng-oncall runbook now.

billing-bot: InvoiceAdjustmentsCreated: ticket BILL-4921 created and assigned to ana for invoice correction work.

maria: Thanks — summarizing action items so we don't lose track: 1) samir — roll fix + run ledger-replay (kickoff 06:00 UTC tomorrow) 2) ana — invoice adjustments, CSV with account_id/invoice_id/original_tokens/corrected_tokens/credit_amount 3) jake — pre-job capacity + alerting 4) maria — track exec update & postmortem follow-up. I'll update the tracker after this thread.

samir: Quick technical note — before replay we need to canonicalize counts to avoid double-crediting. Example verification query I'll run on a 500-account sample first:
```
SELECT account_id, SUM(tokens) as tokens_from_ingest
FROM metering.raw_events
WHERE emitted_at BETWEEN '2026-03-12T02:00:00Z' AND '2026-03-12T04:20:00Z'
GROUP BY account_id;
```
Will attach results and mapping to invoices.

ana: Perfect. Please include invoice_id join in the output. Support prefers CSV columns: account_id, invoice_id, original_tokens, corrected_tokens, credit_amount. Tag as 'billing-late-usage-2026-03-12'.

jake: Also noting this pattern shows up on smaller instance classes under sustained GC pressure. I'll open infra ticket infra-847 to track host sizing and a monthly sweep to prevent recurrence.

maria: One operational policy proposal: if ingestion lag > 1h for any account, mark that billing window as "pending_correction" and exclude it from automated billing cutoff until replay completes. @samir do you think ledger changes are small enough for a quick flag?

samir: Yep — we can add a short window flag (ingest_anomaly) in ledger metadata and have cutoffs ignore flagged windows. I'll include the flag and replay gating in the PR for the replay tooling.

ana: Customer comms: I drafted a short template with apology + credit ETA. I'll hold send until we have final numbers but will prepare support playbook and training. Support will use the label 'billing-late-usage-2026-03-12' when routing.

ops-bot: RunbookCreated: /runbooks/ledger-replay-2026-03-12 created by samir.

maria: Final: I'll run a 48h check-in after the replay completes. If backfill slips past SLAs we escalate to CS ops & legal. Thanks team :thumbsup:
